relationships.subject: HMWH
relationships.evidence_quote: We have previously demonstrated that HMWH attenuates PGE2-induced hyperalgesia in female and male rats

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: TLR4 ODN antisense attenuated HMWH-induced anti-hyperalgesia in gonad-intact male (Fig. 4A), but not in gonad-intact female rats (Fig. 4B).

relationships.subject: MyD88
relationships.evidence_quote: Male rats treated with the MyD88 inhibitor showed attenuation of HMWH-induced anti-hyperalgesia (Fig. 2).

relationships.subject: IRF3
relationships.evidence_quote: Male rats treated with the IRF3 inhibitor did not show attenuation of HMWH-induced anti-hyperalgesia (Fig. 3).

relationships.subject: 17β-estradiol
relationships.evidence_quote: Ovariectomized female rats with 17β-estradiol replacement showed a similar lack of response to TLR4 ODN antisense as observed in gonad-intact females.

key_findings: HMWH anti-hyperalgesia depends on TLR4 via the MyD88 (not IRF3) pathway in male rats, but not in gonad-intact females.
Female TLR4 independence is estrogen-dependent; combined TLR4 plus CD44 antisense nearly abolished HMWH effect in males.
